brief: Explain the automation “Welcome a new lead”.

steps.subject: Thanks for getting in touch
steps.body:
Hi {{firstName|there}},

Thanks for reaching out. We have your message and will reply to this email address.

candidates.note: A reference explanation written by hand of the Welcome a new lead recipe: what starts it, each step in order in the editor's words, and the one thing worth checking.

answer.summary: When a form on your site files a new lead, this automation gives them an owner, books a call for the next day, thanks them by email and tags them.
points: It starts when a new lead is filed, but only when a form filed it.
It gives the lead an owner, taking turns among the teammates in the CRM’s round robin.
It creates a call task due the next day, which goes to that owner.
It emails the lead a thank-you, greeting them by first name, saying their message arrived and will be answered at that address.
suggestions: Check that the round robin under CRM Settings has teammates in it: with nobody in it, the owner step fails and the call task goes to no one.
